title: Don't buy this frame
text: Don't buy this frame. I bought 2 of these frames.  The cardboard that is supposed to protect the corners scuffed up both frames.  All 4 corners were ruined.  I had to buy some Krylon and repaint them.  The little circle on the frame in the picture is a sticker they put right on the front of the frame.  It left adhesive residue that I had to use cleaners to remove.  On the back of the frames there are sawtooth corners to hang the frame.  This means you'll have to put 2 holes in the wall to hang each frame.  Seems like a bit much since the frame is not very heavy. I am very disappointed in this frame.
